brief:
Settlers stole olive harvests near the al-Fawari neighborhood on Yaabad Street in Jenin, the Ma'an news agency reported. The theft occurred as Palestinians prepared for the annual olive harvest, a critical agricultural and economic activity in the occupied West Bank.

The incident is part of a pattern of agricultural disruptions affecting Palestinian farmers in areas near Israeli settlements, which have frequently interfered with harvest operations and land access.
title: Settlers steal olives near Jenin settlement
